content: {"section_decisions": [{"section_index": 0, "source_support_reason": "The source_support_reason is derived from the quote: 'Η Μήλος εν µέσω οθωµανικής κυριαρχίας, το 1677 απέ-κτησε πειρατή βασιλιά!' which directly states that the island of Mylos acquired a pirate king in 1677.", "unsupported_answer_spans": [], "decision": "SUPPORTED"}, {"section_index": 1, "source_support_reason": "The source_support_reason is derived from the quote: 'Ο Ιωάννης Κάψης µε τα αδέρφια του Τροµάρα και Νίκο εξορμούσαν µε δύο γαλέρες από τον Μύτικα της Αιτωλοακαρνανίας και σάλπαραν σε όλο στο Αιγαίο και το Ιόνιο.' which directly mentions Ioannis Kapsis with his brothers Tromara and Niko departing from the Mytikas of Aetolia with two galleys.", "unsupported_answer_spans": [], "decision": "SUPPORTED"}, {"section_index": 2, "source_support_reason": "The source_support_reason is derived from the quote: 'Quelques jours après, on pendait sire Jean Capsi à la porte du bagne.' which directly states that Jean Capsi was hanged at the gate of the bagne.", "unsupported_answer_spans": [], "decision": "SUPPORTED"}] }
